# Kedia Dental Care

> Kedia Dental Care is a premier multi-specialty dental practice located in Forest Park, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. Founded in 2004 by Chief Dental Surgeon Dr. Shiv Dayal Kedia (BDS with 22+ years of clinical mastery), the practice specializes in single-visit root canal therapy, painless laser dentistry, dental implants, and cosmetic smile restorations.

- [Home](https://kediadentalcare.com/): Comprehensive overview of Kedia Dental Care, clinic highlights, doctor profile, patient reviews, and appointment booking.
- [About Dr. Kedia & Team](https://kediadentalcare.com/about): Detailed clinical background of Founder Dr. Shiv Dayal Kedia, in-house dental surgeons, visiting specialists, and clinic history since 2004.
- [All Dental Treatments](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments): Complete index of all 10 specialized dental procedures offered at our Forest Park facility.

- [Best Root Canal Treatment in Bhubaneswar](https://kediadentalcare.com/best-root-canal-treatment-in-bhubaneswar): Guide to painless single-visit rotary endodontics and dental apex locator care.

## Core Clinical Treatments
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/root-canal-therapy): Single-visit computerized rotary endodontics, digital apex locator precision, and diode laser canal sterilization.
- [Laser Dentistry](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/laser-dentistry): Painless, bloodless soft-tissue diode laser gum depigmentation, frenectomy, and bacterial sterilization.
- [Dental Implants](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/dental-implants): Permanent titanium tooth root replacements finished with custom CAD/CAM zirconia aesthetic crowns.
- [Orthodontics & Clear Aligners](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/orthodontics): Transparent teeth aligners, ceramic aesthetic braces, and conventional orthodontic alignment for teens and adults.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Designing](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/cosmetic-dentistry): Custom porcelain veneers, direct composite bonding, and digital smile design harmonization.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/teeth-whitening): Safe, in-office light-activated whitening lifting enamel up to 8 shades in a 45-minute session.
- [Periodontal & Gum Therapy](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/periodontics): Ultrasonic deep scaling, root planing, and antimicrobial laser therapy for bleeding gums.
- [Crowns & Bridges](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/crowns-bridges): Biocompatible metal-free monolithic zirconia crowns and durable aesthetic bridges.
- [Wisdom Tooth Extraction](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/wisdom-tooth-extraction): Atraumatic surgical extractions and impacted third-molar care with rapid recovery.
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://kediadentalcare.com/treatments/pediatric-dentistry): Gentle, fear-free dental treatments, preventative fluoride sealants, and cavity fillings for children.
